name: @dropecho/noise
description: A library of noise generation tools.
author: vantreeseba <vantreeseba@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:haxe && npm run build:example
scripts.build:godot: rm -rf dist/godot/addons/dropecho_noise && haxe build-godot.hxml && cp -R godot/addon/. dist/godot/addons/dropecho_noise/
scripts.package:godot: npm run build:godot && cd dist/godot && rm -f ../dropecho.noise-godot.zip && zip -qr ../dropecho.noise-godot.zip addons
